messages:
Omar: incident-bot just paged on p99 > 3.2s for Solace Systems in eu2 dedicated pool. Observed spike across multiple hosts.
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency breach for tenant=solace-systems pool=dedicated-eu2 metric=p99_latency value=3.62s threshold=2.00s
Jules: I'm pulling metrics. No deploys in last 30m. Any recent autoscaler events?
Ben: Autoscaler didn't fire. Hosts gcu-12..gcu-15 showing high KV cache miss rate and repeated small-batch calls.
Sara: CS: Solace reports interactive tooling lag; their monitoring shows UI ops taking >2s for ~15% of requests. They're on a dedicated pool (SLA 2.5s).
Omar: I'm on it. First action -> isolate traffic to avoid noisy neighbor. @eng-runtime can we shift solace traffic to fallback warm-spare in eu-west?
eng-runtime: running shift now: `POST /internal/routing/shift {"tenant":"solace-systems","from":"dedicated-eu2","to":"fallback-eu-west","weight":100}`
eng-runtime: route change applied, BGP and proxied connections rebalanced, ~10s to converge :thumbsup:
Jules: Metrics after shift: p99 dropped 3.62s -> 2.10s within 30s. p95 back to ~1.1s. Error rate stable ~0.3%. Good signal.
Omar: Great. Next - root cause on dedicated nodes. Ben, can you tail logs for eviction / GC churn?
Ben: Tailing /var/log/runtime on gcu-12..15. Seeing repeated KV eviction loops caused by large-context background job from tenant; it grows working set and thrashes cache.
Sara: CS: Notified Solace support. They confirm a nightly parse job started processing larger batches after last internal deploy and can pause it.
Solace Systems Support: Pausing the job now, will confirm when stopped.
incident-bot: NOTE: on-call handoff to Levi in 25m. Current responders: Omar, Jules, Ben, Sara, eng-runtime.
Omar: Maintain fallback routing for 30m then do canary return: 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Will monitor p95/p99 and errors.
eng-runtime: initiating canary sequence: step1 5% -> wait 60s -> step2 25% -> wait 2m -> step3 100%. Commands logged in routing audit.
Jules: Canary 5%: p99 1.9s. 25%: p99 2.0s. 100%: p99 stabilizing at 2.05s. Slightly above internal 2.0 target but under customer SLA 2.5.
Ben: Recommend adjusting per-tenant cache quota + more aggressive KV eviction for this tenant. Filing INFRA-4821 to track config change and follow-up.
Sara: CS updated Solace: we paused the job, shifted traffic, and performed a controlled return. Solace confirms degraded UX subsided.
Omar: Decision: keep adjusted cache quota + eviction policy for 48h, monitor. If stable, push permanent change and update routing/playbook.
Levi: taking over oncall. I'll open incident ticket INC-2026-709, schedule a 1hr postmortem check-in, and add follow-ups: image verification, routing playbook tweak, and customer runbook update.
customer-success: Solace confirms their nightly job is paused and that latency is back to normal. They thanked the SRE team. :tada:
Jules: Quick note to ops docs: add a specific checklist for dedicated-tenant KV thrash: isolate -> shift -> canary -> quota tweak -> follow-up ticket. Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-tenant-noise
incident-bot: Incident marked mitigated. Re-open if p99 > 2.5s for tenant=solace-systems. Closed for now.
